phase05_teacher_ema999.__doc__:
Stage5 reproduction with the requested EMA decay 0.999.

All inherited data, augmentation, loss, optimizer, runner, and evaluation
settings are kept unchanged. MMCV's EMAHook takes momentum, where
decay = 1 - momentum, so decay 0.999 requires momentum 0.001.

phase06_detail_sampling.__doc__:
Stage6 single-teacher target adaptation with native-resolution crops.

The teacher is the frozen Stage5 checkpoint itself. No Stage4/Stage5 score
fusion is used, so the resulting checkpoint remains a single submitted model.
